## Starter project

[Download labexam.zip](downloads/labexam.zip){.btn .btn-primary}

The zip has an empty RStudio project with this structure:

```
labexam/
├── labexam.Rproj                   ← double-click to open the project
├── Lastname_Firstname_labexam.R    ← rename it; headers only, you write the code
├── README.txt
├── data/                           ← put ess.csv and the ANES file from Moodle here
└── output/
```

1. Unzip it somewhere you'll find it again, e.g. `Documents/QM1/labexam`.
2. Copy the data from Moodle into `data/`. The zip has no data.
3. Double-click `labexam.Rproj`, then `read.csv("data/ess.csv")` works without `setwd()`.
4. Install the packages once, in the Console:

   ```r
   install.packages(c("dplyr", "lmtest", "car", "margins", "nnet"))
   ```

The template only has section headers and `# Interpretation:` prompts. The code and the sentences are yours, so no two submissions look the same.

## The data used on this site

Small extracts with only the lab variables (values unchanged), built from the lab files:

- [anes_lab.csv](data/anes_lab.csv) (ANES 2024)
- [ess_lab.csv](data/ess_lab.csv) (ESS round 11)
- [students.csv](data/students.csv) (Lab 1)
